programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E01 — New York Superstorms New York City is under attack as Hurricanes Ida and Ian unleash their fury on innocent people; seeing how the latest science and technology can protect New York City's 8 million residents before everything gets swept away by ferocious superstorms.
programme.title: Brink of Disaster

programme.desc: The Falcon Lake Incident Delve into one of the most well-documented UFO cases in Canada; learn about the physical effects that this 1967 close encounter had on amateur geologist Stephen Michalak.
programme.title: UFO Chronicles

programme.desc: Peni Military Base Incident Witness an encounter with a strange humanoid that is more than two meters tall; review the eyewitness accounts of Jesús Jofre and two of his fellow soldiers, who came face to face with this possible alien and saw a UFO hovering near their barracks.
programme.title: UFO Chronicles

programme.desc: S01 E06 — When Spirits Talk Ordinary people fear for their safety after receiving terrifying messages from beyond the grave.
